Naveen (arch): quick sync: outage repro showed hosted->private route failing because private adapters reject CP-issued tokens. need a minimal, auditable handshake for routing without sending raw tenant creds.
Ivy (eng-runtime): saw that too. adapter returns 403 audience mismatch during fallback.
Tom (eng-platform): proposal: capability discovery + signed "route-proof" that adapters verify. adapter exposes GET /v1/capabilities with cert thumbprint and POST /v1/verify-proof to validate CP-signed proof.
Marta (sec): constraints: proofs must be short-lived (<=30s hot), include nonce/rid to prevent replay, and enumerate minimal caps (route, model-pin). always emit audit event on accept.
Lina (product): onboarding: cert exchange ok if automated; private customers should opt-in during setup; document in checklist.
Ivy (eng-runtime): perf caveat: per-request signature verify adds latency. mitigation: HMAC fast-path for trusted hosted<->dedicated, cached verification entries with tiny TTL, or async pre-warm verify.
Tom (eng-platform): for customer-managed KMS where CP can't sign acceptable proofs, adapters must offer an exchange endpoint: POST /v1/exchange-request -> returns local short token after adapter policy checks (similar to exchange-handle).
Marta (sec): require audit: proof.accepted events with proof_id, origin, caps, resolved_by and require a revocation endpoint /v1/revoke-proof for emergencies.
Naveen (arch): implementation checklist: discovery at route init, CP signing service with short-lived keys, runtime verify or proxy to adapter verify endpoint, metric windows for proof_verify_latency and fail_rate.
Tom (eng-platform): ops: add alerts for proof_verify_fail_rate > 0.5% over 5m, ticket created by ci-bot.
ci-bot: created ticket INF-913: add proof verification metrics and alerts.
Marta (sec): also include key rotation guidance and test vectors in RFC.
Ivy (eng-runtime): plan: spike verify perf next week, implement opt-in HMAC fast-path for internal flows, feature-flag rollout.
Lina (product): target docs + onboarding automation in 2 sprints for new private customers. existing customers can opt in; we'll coordinate messaging.
Naveen (arch): closing: do not transmit raw tenant credentials outside KMS, use proof or adapter-side exchange, ensure auditability and fail-closed by default. I'll author the RFC with diagrams. thanks all.
ci-bot: milestone created: adapter-proof-handshake (owner: ivy)
